entries.name: ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID
entries.summary: Required env-quad var for OIDC Federation auth: the federation rule id from the Anthropic console.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID
entries.summary: Required env-quad var for OIDC Federation auth: the target organization id.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN
entries.summary: Inline identity token (JWT) for OIDC Federation auth; alternative to ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE
entries.summary: Path to a rotating identity-token file for OIDC Federation auth.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID
entries.summary: Optional service-account id for OIDC Federation auth.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_SCOPE
entries.summary: Optional auth-scope override for OIDC Federation auth.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_CONFIG_DIR
entries.summary: Overrides the config-directory root used for profile-based auth config (configs/, credentials/).

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_PROFILE
entries.summary: Selects the active profile within the config dir; falls back to <config_dir>/active_config then "default".

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HTTP_PROXY
entries.summary: Lowest-priority HTTP proxy fallback, below HTTP_PROXY/http_proxy; propagated to ~15 downstream toolchains (npm, docker, JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS, gcloud, etc.) for spawned children.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HTTPS_PROXY
entries.summary: Lowest-priority HTTPS proxy fallback, below HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
entries.summary: Alias for CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE; when truthy, replaces the full system prompt with a skeletal CWD/Date-only prompt.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
entries.summary: Enables a retry watchdog on API 429s; strictly gated to Linux + CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT="remote" (CCR/daemon workers, not local dev machines).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT
entries.summary: Truthy env override that force-enables /fork ahead of the tengu_copper_fox GB flag (default false); non-interactive sessions never see /fork regardless.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_TIER
entries.summary: Overrides the reported rate-limit tier on the client-constructed OAuth token object (client-side only; server remains authoritative).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE
entries.summary: Overrides the reported subscription type on the client-constructed OAuth token object; test-hook surface for Pro-trial/subscription UI.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_SESSION
entries.summary: Single-use session id for the bridge reattach handshake; read once and deleted from process.env so it does not leak into grandchildren.

provenance.note: fully consumed by the bg/bridge persistence path

entries.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_SEQ
entries.summary: Single-use sequence number to replay from on bridge reattach; read once and deleted from process.env.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_NAME
entries.summary: Removed in v2.1.118; agent/team display context is now derived from session state (standaloneAgentContext) instead of an env override.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEAM_NAME
entries.summary: Removed alongside CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_NAME in v2.1.118.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_KIND
entries.summary: Session-kind discriminator: "bg" | "daemon" | "daemon-worker" | unset (interactive). The canonical Cowork/background-session detector; there is no literal "cowork" string in the bundle.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID
entries.summary: Stable session identifier for cross-process correlation.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_NAME
entries.summary: Human-readable session name shown in the agents/Fleet view list.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_LOG
entries.summary: Path to the session log file.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_ISOLATION
entries.summary: Background-isolation mode; value "worktree" triggers runtime system-prompt rewriting instructing the agent to call EnterWorktree before editing.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_RENDEZVOUS_SOCK
entries.summary: Unix-socket path for daemon<->worker IPC; used to send shutdown signals to idle/retired workers (tengu_bg_retired).

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_SOURCE
entries.summary: Records where a background session was spawned from (set by the daemon when dispatching workers).

entries.name: CLAUDE_JOB_DIR
entries.summary: Per-job state directory: worktree, transcript, and PTY recording all live here.

entries.name: CLAUDE_PTY_RECORD
entries.summary: File path for terminal-stream recording via the internal --bg-pty-host <sock> <cols> <rows> -- <file> argv mode.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT
entries.summary: Agent identifier set when running as a Fleet/agent-view-tracked agent.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENTS_SELECT
entries.summary: Pre-selected agent id to highlight in the agents (Fleet) view; set when the left-arrow keybinding spawns a child "claude agents" process.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT
entries.summary: Internal agent identity for the Claude Code instance, parallel to the agent-config concept.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD
entries.summary: UI privacy knob: when truthy, blanks the cwd field in the status-line/header display (does not affect actual cwd). Useful for screensharing.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_VERIFY_PROMPT
entries.summary: Debugging-workflow discipline toggle, NOT a safety gate: injects a 3-step reproduce->fix->re-observe instruction section into the system prompt. Sibling GB flag: tengu_sparrow_ledger.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLASSIFIER_SUMMARY
entries.summary: Manual override for classifier-summary engine selection: truthy -> "llm", falsy -> "heuristic"; bypasses GB-flag-driven default.

entries.name: CLAUDE_INTERNAL_FC_OVERRIDES
entries.summary: Internal function-calling overrides; no user-facing surface as of v2.1.119.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DAEMON_COLD_START
entries.summary: Daemon cold-start mode: "transient" (silent on-demand, default) or "ask" (prompt before starting). There is no persistent/installed mode in v2.1.120.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_LEAN_PROMPT
entries.summary: Manual override forcing all leanable prompt sections (per-section, distinct from wholesale CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE) to their slim variants regardless of GB-flag rollout state.

entries.name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES
entries.summary: Cowork's memory-injection bypass: when set and auto-memory is enabled, wholesale replaces the entire memory pipeline output with the env var's content (no team memory, no MEMORY.md index).

entries.name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_EXTRA_GUIDELINES
entries.summary: Additive Cowork memory-guidance hint, pre-existing since v2.1.118; sibling of the replace-form CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES added in v2.1.120. Its value is sourced from GrowthBook string-config gate 2860753854 (default: a hardcoded "## Sensitive personal information..." PII-handling block) -- see gate.2860753854 (v2.23.0 addendum).

provenance.note: value-gate mechanism (2860753854) added v2.23.0

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENTS_AUTO_RELAUNCHED_AT
entries.summary: Daemon-set timestamp on auto-relaunched workers; rate-limited to agents unfocused >=1h and >=6h since the last relaunch.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOWS
entries.summary: Tri-state availability override for Dynamic Workflows (the Workflow tool): truthy pulls from tengu_workflows_enabled, explicit-false disables, unset falls through to Statsig+plan default.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS
entries.summary: Hard kill switch for Dynamic Workflows, checked before org policy/availability.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_MODE
entries.summary: Enables the coordinator dispatch role (worker-team orchestration, TeamCreate/TeamDelete); remote/headless-gated.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL
entries.summary: Global effort-tier pin overriding the per-model default (low|medium|high|xhigh|max), clamped to model capability.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE
entries.summary: Truthy downgrades Opus 4.8 to Opus 4.6 (the inverse direction of the older 4.6->4.7 fast-mode var).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_OPUS_4_7_FAST_MODE
entries.summary: Opt-in fast mode for Opus 4.7. Removed in v2.1.159 (the 4.6->4.7-era fast-mode var was retired alongside the Opus 4.8 launch) but reappears as a live, functioning var by v2.1.198 complementing CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE.

provenance.note: removed in v2.1.159
live again as of v2.1.198

entries.name: CLAUDE_BYTE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: Byte-level stream idle-watchdog timeout, default 300000ms via Statsig, clamped [10000, 1800000]; takes precedence over the legacy CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.

entries.name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG
entries.summary: Kill/force switch for the byte-level idle watchdog (on by default for SSE).

entries.name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG_BEDROCK
entries.summary: Opt-in byte watchdog for the Bedrock eventstream transport (off by default, unlike SSE).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP
entries.summary: Consecutive Stop-hook block override ceiling, default 8; <=0 disables the cap.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE
entries.summary: Required to enable auto permission mode on non-first-party/non-anthropicAws providers (first-party has it always available).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY
entries.summary: Present only in the env-name allowlist and never actually read; does NOT select the new Cloud-gateway OAuth provider (that is chosen via /login). Dead/reserved.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS
entries.summary: Pure-env truthy gate (default OFF) enabling org-managed skills reconcile from Console, with a 10-minute re-sync.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS
entries.summary: Pure-env truthy gate (default OFF) enabling org-managed plugins reconcile from Console, plus MCP reconcile.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: MCP-reconcile timeout bound for org-managed plugin sync, default 10000ms; tengu_plugins_sync_mcp_skipped fires only when explicitly set to 0.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: Plugin-install timeout bound for org-managed plugin sync, default 30000ms.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: Skills-sync startup-wait bound for org-managed skills sync, default 5000ms.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL
entries.summary: Suppresses the dark-launched built-in "claude-code-docs" CLI-as-skill (registerClaudeCodeSkill, default off via tengu_birch_kettle).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_OAUTH_REFRESH
entries.summary: Capability flag: an embedding host (Desktop, VS Code, local-agent) supplies a getOAuthToken callback for SDK-embedded sessions.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH
entries.summary: Capability flag: an embedding host supplies a getHostAuthToken callback; covers a narrower entrypoint set than OAuth refresh (excludes claude-vscode).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_ENV_VAR
entries.summary: Names the env var holding the host-managed auth token, default ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN; its presence flips managedByHost.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.summary: Overrides the default 30000ms timeout on the host_auth_token_refresh / oauth_token_refresh control-request RPCs.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_AUTH_SNAPSHOT_PATH
entries.summary: Single-use on-disk credential handoff for background workers: path is read, the env var deleted, and the file unlinked after installing {accessToken, scopes, subscriptionType, rateLimitTier}.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID
entries.summary: Workspace-disambiguation var read in OIDC env-quad mode alongside organization_id/federation_rule_id. NOT the Cowork Spaces id, despite the name overlap.

provenance.note: confirmed still the L86 OIDC var, not the Spaces id

entries.name: CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR
entries.summary: Relocates secure credential storage away from the default ~/.claude.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST
entries.summary: Truthy forces managedByHost auth mode even without CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_ENV_VAR being set.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW
entries.summary: Disables the "agent view" (renamed from CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENTS_FLEET/"Fleet view"); the underlying `claude agents` command behavior is unchanged, only naming.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_VIEW_RELAUNCH
entries.summary: One-shot marker set around the Fleet->agent-view rename migration.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_SESSION_PERMISSION_RULES
entries.summary: JSON {allow[],deny[]} injected as session-scoped alwaysAllow/alwaysDenyRules for bg sessions only (SESSION_KIND==="bg"); user-configured, not a hardcoded always-ask list.

provenance.note: confirmed user-configured, not hardcoded

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_TCC_DISCLAIMED
entries.summary: macOS one-shot marker for native self-respawn after a TCC (privacy permission) disclaim.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUPERVISED
entries.summary: When set, an uncaught exception triggers a clean exit instead of a crash dump, for a supervising process to restart.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SPAWN_TIMESTAMP_MS
entries.summary: Records the process spawn timestamp (ms).

entries.name: CLAUDE_PTY_HOST_EXEC
entries.summary: PTY host executable path used by the internal --bg-pty-host argv mode.

entries.name: CLAUDE_PTY_ORPHAN_CHECK_MS
entries.summary: PTY orphan-check polling interval, default 2000ms.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_OUTBOUND_ONLY
entries.summary: Restricts bridge reattach to outbound-only connections.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE
entries.summary: Force-enables the /loop keepalive fallback wakeup (over the tengu_kairos_loop_keepalive Statsig default false); strictly subordinate to dynamic-loop mode.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_MODE_INTERVIEW_PHASE
entries.summary: The interactive "interview" phase on entering plan mode is fully removed in v2.1.159, along with its two telemetry flags.

entries.name: CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES
entries.summary: JSON array mounting multiple team-memory stores (path string or {path, mode: rw|ro, mount}); duplicate mounts throw.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_MEMORY_TOGGLED_OFF
entries.summary: Propagates a memory-off state into background child sessions.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PEWTER_OWL
entries.summary: Hard on/off override for the PEWTER_OWL gate layer over the internal SendUserMessage/Brief tool (off-override beats all; force-on also supported).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_IS_COWORK
entries.summary: The activation marker for Cowork mode; selected by this env var, not a CLI flag (--cowork itself is rejected at agent-invocation time, plugin-scope only). Visibility caveat (L116): under host-loop this var lives on the HOST-side agent process only -- a skill's shell commands run in the sealed-env VM (mcp__workspace__bash) and do not see it, so a bare env check false-negatives in production Cowork; it is also the switch that force-disables inline skill-shell execution (q5n/disableSkillShellExecution).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_COWORK_PLUGINS
entries.summary: Do NOT set: flips the agent user-settings file to cowork_settings.json and plugin cache to cowork_plugins/ -- files the Desktop host never populates. The real Desktop never sets it; toggling it is an active bug, not a working switch.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT
entries.summary: Bypasses the per-model effort allowlist (effort is otherwise limited to fable-5/mythos-5/opus-4-8/opus-4-7 + select models).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_APPEND_SUBAGENT_PROMPT
entries.summary: Gates appendSubagentSystemPrompt on the initialize control-request (subagent system-prompt append).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE
entries.summary: Combined with CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_HERMETIC_MODE, triggers the ap5()/xB8() filter that drops non-SDK --mcp-config servers in hermetic-remote mode; also gates several CCR-era flags (tengu_ccr_post_turn_summary, retry watchdog).

provenance.note: earlier CCR gating context

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_HERMETIC_MODE
entries.summary: Paired with CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE; both required for xB8() hermetic-remote mode, which drops non-SDK --mcp-config servers.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
entries.summary: The Desktop's VM-env builder rtA() sets this to the session OAuth token for a spawned Cowork agent; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/AUTH_TOKEN/CUSTOM_HEADERS are deleted (not blanked) alongside it, so the final env has no API-key vars at all.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKER_EPOCH
entries.summary: CCR worker epoch (int) passed in by the host; a stale end_session (reason:"archived") is ignored when epoch>1 so a prior lifecycle cannot kill a reattached worker. Missing/NaN throws "missing_epoch".

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT
entries.summary: Stops selecting/routing to [1m]-tagged models, for proxies/gateways without 1M-context support.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING
entries.summary: Suppresses adaptive (extended) thinking even on supporting models (opus-4-6/sonnet-4-6).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LEGACY_MODEL_REMAP
entries.summary: Disables the silent old-alias -> canonical-model-ID remap; sends the exact model string as given.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_BG_CLASSIFIER_MODEL
entries.summary: Overrides the model used for the background classifier/summarizer that produces post-turn summaries for Cowork Desktop.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL
entries.summary: Overrides the model auto-mode selects.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
entries.summary: Fable-5 model-family override quartet (+ _NAME, _DESCRIPTION, _SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES), matching the existing OPUS/SONNET/HAIKU pattern; in the managed-settings propagation allowlist so org policy reaches subagents.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENVIRONMENT_KIND
entries.summary: Deployment-type tag: byoc | anthropic_cloud | bridge; drives the classifier-summary surface map (byoc adds "ccr", bridge adds "bridge"). CONFIRMED mechanism (L119): the "bridge" value is set exclusively by the agent's OWN claude remote-control bridge worker (a poll/ack/stop client against /v1/environments/{id}/work) when it spawns a child CLI process to run a claimed work item -- the Desktop never assigns this value itself (0 spawn-env assignments found in either Desktop build). A Desktop-hosted bridge session reaches the same "bridge" classifier surface via a separate signal, the in-process flag replBridgeActive (qR()), not this env var -- the surface map ORs both. byoc/anthropic_cloud are sibling environment-PROVIDER kinds of the same /v1/environment_providers API and feed the "ccr" surface, not "bridge".

provenance.note: mechanism confirmed: set by the agent's own remote-control bridge worker at child-spawn time, not by the Desktop; Desktop-hosted bridge sessions reach the same surface via replBridgeActive instead

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_BYOC_ENABLE_DATADOG
entries.summary: Under ENVIRONMENT_KIND=byoc, Datadog telemetry is suppressed unless this is also set.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKSPACE_HOST_PATHS
entries.summary: Pipe-separated host folders the Desktop injects (userSelectedFolders.join("|")); the agent emits them as workspace.host_paths telemetry. Host-side source is a Cowork Space's folder set (Ch26/L109).

provenance.note: confirmed as the host-side surface behind a Space's folderPath set

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_CLAIM_AUTH
entries.summary: Part of the bg/Cowork auth handshake carrying host->worker claim auth; deleted from process.env immediately after read (single-use).

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_SOCKET_TOKENS_PATH
entries.summary: Part of the bg/Cowork auth handshake carrying the socket-tokens path; deleted from process.env immediately after read.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_RV_AUTH
entries.summary: Rendezvous-socket auth token for the bg/Cowork handshake; single-use, deleted after read.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_PTY_AUTH
entries.summary: PTY-socket auth token for the bg/Cowork handshake; single-use, deleted after read.

entries.name: CLAUDE_BG_STARTUP_WEDGE_MS
entries.summary: Startup-watchdog timeout for hung bg workers, default 45000ms; firing kills the worker.

entries.name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_INDEX_CONTENT
entries.summary: Injects the Cowork memory index as a raw string (non-empty = use directly, empty = disable, unset = use file path); sibling of CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES.

provenance.note: Desktop counterpart is CoworkSpaces per-space auto-memory (getAutoMemoryDir)

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_XAA
entries.summary: Gates the XAA (Cross-App Authentication, SEP-990) OIDC flow for MCP OAuth; without it, any oauth.xaa server config throws.

entries.name: CLAUDE_TRUSTED_DEVICE_TOKEN
entries.summary: Injects a trusted-device token directly, skipping proactive device-trust enrollment.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DONT_INHERIT_ENV
entries.summary: Bash-tool subprocesses get an empty base env (only SHELL/GIT_EDITOR/CLAUDECODE=1) instead of inheriting process.env; hermetic shell mode.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_CLIENT_APP
entries.summary: Appended as client-app/<val> in the User-Agent/x-app header for Agent SDK integrations.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_VERSION
entries.summary: Appended as agent-sdk/<val> in the User-Agent header.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_MCP_NO_PREFIX
entries.summary: Suppresses the tool-name prefix for MCP tools on sdk-type connections.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS
entries.summary: With the multi-agent fork gate, returns an empty built-in-agents list for SDK integrations.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_V2_AGENT_COUNT
entries.summary: Overrides the Dynamic-Workflow (plan-v2) main parallel-agent count (default tier-based: enterprise/team 3, else 1).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPLORE_AGENT_COUNT
entries.summary: Overrides the Dynamic-Workflow explore parallel-agent count; L108 shorthand renders this as CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_V2_..._EXPLORE_AGENT_COUNT while L111 gives the standalone name -- treat as the same explore-fan-out override, exact full identifier unconfirmed.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_COLD_COMPACT
entries.summary: Triggers cold compaction (discard the whole in-flight conversation) instead of normal summary-preserving autocompact.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AFTER_LAST_COMPACT
entries.summary: Appends {after_last_compact:true} to the skill/plugin-registry API query (skill sync after compaction).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS
entries.summary: Three-way toggle for Git guidance in the system prompt (truthy=off, falsy-string=force-on, unset=policy default).

entries.name: CLAUDE_AI_URL
entries.summary: Desktop-only: overrides the claude.ai base URL (staging/localhost detection); explicitly stripped before spawning the agent.

entries.name: CLAUDE_EXTRA_HEADERS_TOKEN
entries.summary: Desktop-only: a signed JWT (verified against an embedded public key) injecting extra HTTP headers into API requests; rejected tokens just warn.

entries.name: CLAUDE_UPDATER_TOKEN
entries.summary: Desktop-only: a signed JWT overriding the auto-updater config (server URL/channel).

entries.name: CLAUDE_DESKTOP_LOCAL_FRAME_SHELL
entries.summary: Desktop-only: "=1" enables the local-frame-shell render path (embedded webviews; alters link-click handling and CSP for sub-frames).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS
entries.summary: Gates the agent-side Tasks tool family (TaskCreate/TaskList/TaskGet/TaskUpdate/TaskStop/TaskOutput), decision fn vv(); pairs with CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID (D$()). Behind the force-ON tasks_tab experiment (gate 364911507).

provenance.note: binary-verified, in-VM ELF 2.1.197

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID
entries.summary: Pins the persistent task-list id for the Tasks tool family; same insider-experiment posture as CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS.

entries.name: CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS
entries.summary: When truthy, auto-moves long-running work to a background task after ~120s (Rbm()).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS
entries.summary: Disables background subagents. Effects (v2.1.198): removes run_in_background from the Task tool's model-facing schema (fLo's sJt branch) so subagents run synchronously; suppresses the "run_in_background: true" hint; makes SendMessage-resume of a stopped agent run to completion inline instead of resuming in the background. Set to "1" in the env block of the MAIN Cowork local-agent spawn (asar 1.18286.0) -- i.e. every Cowork session, alongside CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENTS_FLEET.

provenance.note: schema omission + synchronous resume + main-Cowork-spawn siting

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING
entries.summary: Keeps a session's status as "not idle" while its background tasks are still running.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
entries.summary: Enables SDK file checkpointing/rewind (the rewind_files control-request + file_snapshot system message); overridden off by CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
entries.summary: Kill switch overriding CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_REMOTE_RECAP
entries.summary: Enables the remote/away recap path, pairing with the away_summary control-protocol subtype; extends the L101 proactive-away-summary feature to the remote/Cowork surface.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_DESIGN_MCP
entries.summary: Enables the Claude Design MCP server backing /design; gated off by default alongside pNe() and the other ENABLE_DESIGN_* vars.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_DESIGN_SYNC
entries.summary: Enables /design-sync (push design-system components to claude.ai/design).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DESIGN_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
entries.summary: OAuth client id used by the /design-login flow.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT
entries.summary: Force enable/disable the Artifact tool in otherwise-excluded entrypoints; master reachability is still the tengu_cobalt_plinth GB flag (default false).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT
entries.summary: Kill switch for the Artifact tool (pairs with the disableArtifact setting).

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACTS_API_BASE_URL
entries.summary: Artifacts upload API base URL; stripped from child-process environments.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_DIRECT_UPLOAD

entries.name: mcp_call

entries.name: microcompact_boundary
entries.summary: type:"system" subtype string for micro-compaction, sibling of compact_boundary — but ASYMMETRIC: in the in-VM ELF 2.1.197 (identical host CLI 2.1.201) compact_boundary has 8 subtype:"compact_boundary" stream-emit producer sites, while microcompact_boundary has 0 — its only two occurrences are a string-table constant and one Ink TUI renderer case that renders nothing (if(subtype==="microcompact_boundary")return null). So micro-compaction is render-only and suppressed, NOT serialized into stream-json. A stream/headless compaction_occurred signal should key on compact_boundary; keying on microcompact_boundary catches nothing on this evidence.

Default-enabled in the plain CLI (no isEnabled of its own); the il() agent-teams gate only shapes its structured-message schema. In Cowork it is ABSENT from the Desktop spawn's explicit tools:/allowedTools: lists, making resume unreachable there.

entries.name: Task
entries.summary: Subagent dispatch. Input schema (THm/SHm/fLo): description, prompt, subagent_type, model, run_in_background, name, team_name (deprecated), mode, isolation, cwd -- NO resume parameter; every call spawns a fresh agent (tengu_agent_tool_selected is_resume:false). run_in_background is omitted from the schema when CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS is set or the fork experiment (PX()) is active; cwd is always omitted model-facing. Continuation lives elsewhere: SendMessage resume (tool.SendMessage), subagent_type 'fork' (inherits full conversation context), Workflow resumeFromRunId.

entries.name: 2614807392 (.host-home skeleton-path index)
entries.summary: Governs whether the system prompt tells the agent about the `.host-home` mount name and its path-translation semantics. `.host-home` is not a real bind mount -- Ch31/L117's rootfs mount-unit inventory found no corresponding systemd unit -- it's a synthetic index resolved by ece()/uCe() that lets the agent reference absolute host paths (e.g. `/sessions/<id>/mnt/.host-home/<sub>` <-> a real host path) without the host home directory ever being shared. OFF (dark, absent from fcache) for the standard client.

provenance.note: explains the .host-home mount-name reservation structurally

entries.name: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
entries.summary: Template token + injected env var resolving to the plugin's own --plugin-dir (agent sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT: t.path). Under Cowork the Desktop picks the dir per mode: Ei = isHostLoopModeEnabled ? qX(installPath) : sdkPath. Host-loop (production) => host-side claude-hostloop-plugins/<hash> staging path, accepted by host file tools (Read/Edit/Glob/Grep) but useless to in-VM bash (mcp__workspace__bash), which must use the VM mount /sessions/<id>/mnt/.local-plugins|.remote-plugins/... instead. VM-loop (requireCoworkFullVmSandbox orgs, whole agent in-VM) => sdkPath = that VM mount, so bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/x.sh works. Decisive: claude-hostloop-plugins is absent from both agent binaries (host CLI 2.1.201, in-VM ELF 2.1.197), present only in app.asar, so L89's 'host-side EVERYWHERE' is host-loop-only. Host-loop qX mechanics: space-triggered (returns the raw install path unless it contains a space) and deterministic (sha256(installPath).slice(0,16), stable across invocations/sessions/reboots). Third minor site: injected into a plugin-owned MCP server's headersHelper exec env. Host-loop mechanics live-confirmed 2026-07-07 (exact sha256(installPath)[:16] match + cross-session stability via docs/internal/cowork-pluginroot-probe); VM-loop resolution static-derived from the branch.

entries.name: ccr-byoc-2025-07-29
entries.summary: anthropic-beta header sent with claude.ai cloud-session-creation requests (teleportToCloud's POST /v1/sessions, and the bridge-session ingress-token exchange); present byte-similarly in Desktop 1.18286.2 and 1.19367.0, so not new to either build -- confirmed used at two independent POST call sites. Paired with anthropic-client-feature: ccr and x-organization-uuid.

entries.name: LocalAgentModeSessions
entries.summary: 95 methods total, ZERO diff between Desktop 1.18286.2 and 1.19367.0 (direct sorted-set comparison). This entry catalogs specifically its bridge-session-worker subset, confirmed via real ipcRenderer channel-string evidence: consent/scope (getBridgeConsent, getSessionsBridgeEnabled, addTrustedFolder, grantRemoteSessionFolders, browseAndGrantRemoteSessionFolder, grantRemoteSessionFolder, clearRemoteSessionFolderGrants), permission gating (onBridgePermissionPreflight event + respondBridgePermissionPreflight invoke -- same shape as local onToolPermissionRequest/respondToToolPermission but remote-initiated), and session control (kickBridgePoll, abandonBridgeEnvironment). See ipc.LocalSessions_cloudTeleport for the sibling findLocalSessionIdForBridgeId method, which lives on LocalSessions instead.

entries.name: LocalSessions (cloud-teleport methods)
entries.summary: Scoped subset of the pre-existing LocalSessions interface: teleportToCloud(sessionId, environmentId) re-hosts a local session to the cloud via checkReadiness (remote-session rejection -- generalized in 1.19367.0 from an sshConfig-only check to a broader remoteTarget check, the one genuine NEW-vs-OLD code delta found in this investigation -- plus OAuth-token presence and clean-working-tree checks) -> pushBranch (progress pushing_branch) -> stop local session -> generateTranscriptSummary (progress generating_summary) -> POST ${claudeAiUrl}/v1/sessions (progress creating_session; beta ccr-byoc-2025-07-29) -> returns {sessionId, title, url, summary} where url is an ABSOLUTE https://claude.ai/code/<id>. getTeleportReadiness runs the same three gated checks standalone. findLocalSessionIdForBridgeId(e) resolves via r.findSessionIdByBridgeSessionId(e)??null. childKind discriminator ("cloud"|"local") is validated only as a string client-side, not as an enum.

entries.name: LocalSessions / LocalAgentModeSessions (effort + extended-thinking methods)
entries.summary: setEffort/setExtendedThinking (also on LocalAgentModeSessions)/getEffort/getDefaultEffort/setFastMode. Spawn-time resolution is settings-file-driven, NOT CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL-backed (corrects L114): effort = qgi(effortOverride, A1e(model)=settings.effortByModel[model], E2t()=settings.effort||"medium"); extended thinking = zgi(enabled, override, killSwitch) yielding maxThinkingTokens strictly 31999 or 0 (NX=31999), never an arbitrary budget. Four per-model effort classes: literal picker models (s1r map), no-picker models (still emit --effort medium), fable/mythos regex-default class (o1r/i1r, disallowThinkingDisabled:true), unknown models (no config). Delivered exclusively as CLI flags (--effort <level>, --max-thinking-tokens <N> / --thinking disabled); CLAUDE_EFFORT and MAX_THINKING_TOKENS are no-ops as env vars at spawn. Live-session setEffort calls query.applyFlagSettings({effortLevel}); live-session setExtendedThinking calls query.setMaxThinkingTokens(enabled?31999:0) -- first concrete payload shapes for the apply_flag_settings / set_max_thinking_tokens control-protocol subtypes.
